title_zh: 演练前核对离开教室的路线

scenario.goal_zh: 按校方演练图确认出口与集合地点并转达同学。

context_zh: 教师在一次预定地震演练前回答班级协助员的路线问题。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.text: For the earthquake drill, which exit should our class use after you tell us to leave?

sentences.speaker: Ms Patel
sentences.text: Follow the route on this school plan to the door at the end of our corridor.

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.text: Is that the door beside the library?

sentences.speaker: Ms Patel
sentences.text: Yes. Then we go to the marked class meeting point on the field.

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.text: What if someone is in the library when the drill starts?

sentences.speaker: Ms Patel
sentences.text: The library staff will guide them. Do not go back through the building to find them.

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.text: Understood. I will point out our route to the class before the practice begins.
